reason: A DSH usage analytics dashboard that aggregates session log metrics by vendor and model, presenting heatmaps, charts, drilldowns, health cards, cost estimates, and CSV exports.

summaries.zh: 按厂商和模型汇总 DeepSeek Harness 会话用量，并通过热力图、趋势图、明细表和 CSV 导出提供可视化统计。
summaries.en: Aggregates DeepSeek Harness session usage by vendor and model with heatmaps, trend charts, detail tables, and CSV export.

capabilities: Reads durable session logs for usage metrics
Aggregates token, model, vendor, performance, and error statistics
Stores vendor aliases, types, and unit prices in local persistent storage
Serves local usage data through web routes
